hello.text: Hello, little one. I'm drawing water from the well.

bridge.text: The river is high this week. I'm glad we have a strong bridge to keep us all together.

beans.text: Miriam tells me you planted beans with her. When they come in, maybe we'll all share a supper.

bread.text: Was it you who filled our bread basket? Two rolls, one for me and one for my husband. Thank you, little one.
